historical_research_register.use: Primary standards-body material reproducing IEC LI 30/90 front-time and virtual-origin definitions. Relevant diagram inspected.

historical_research_register.title: Yutthagowith, An Accurate Evaluation of Switching Impulse Voltages for High-Voltage Tests, Energies 15(13),4760 (2022), DOI 10.3390/en15134760
historical_research_register.use: Primary research: legacy SI target/tolerances, actual origin, broad/noisy peak evaluation; not blanket endorsement of every approximation in the paper.

historical_research_register.title: J. R. Lucas, High Voltage Engineering (2001), chapter 8, University of Moratuwa
historical_research_register.use: University HV source: two distinct two-capacitor impulse circuits, distributed Marx/Goodlet shaping, stray-capacitance effects. Relevant circuit diagrams inspected.

historical_research_register.use: Generic manufacturer evidence for Marx charging/erection, modular resistors, grounding apparatus and optional test circuits; NOT the CPRI model/datasheet. Relevant page inspected.

historical_research_register.title: Lewin et al., Zero-Phase Filtering for Lightning Impulse Evaluation, IEEE Transactions on Power Delivery 23(1),3–12 (2008), DOI 10.1109/TPWRD.2007.911124
historical_research_register.use: Primary author-uploaded paper: double-exponential base curve and zero-phase residual filtering for LI overshoot; motivates gated, separately validated evaluator plugin.

historical_research_register.title: IEC 61083-2:2013 — official publication page
historical_research_register.use: Impulse-evaluation software and reference test-data qualification. TDG not obtained or executed.

historical_research_register.use: Implicit ODE integration and dense output; installed/tested SciPy version recorded separately.

historical_research_register.title: ngspice official manual
historical_research_register.use: Independent transient reference netlists/initial-condition semantics; decks supplied, ngspice not available/executed in this environment.

historical_research_register.title: K. M. Coetzer, P. G. Wiid, A. J. Rix, An investigation into the failure mechanisms of Schottky barrier diodes, as commonly implemented as bypass diodes in photovoltaic modules; Stellenbosch University conference paper
historical_research_register.use: Section 2.1 independently reproduces LI crest ±3%, front ±30%, tail ±20% and IEC-derived waveform definitions; no transfer of its small-generator hardware to CPRI.

historical_research_register.title: Non-Iterative Technique for Determination of Full Lightning Impulse Voltage Parameters, Energies 15(12),4199 (2022), DOI 10.3390/en15124199
historical_research_register.use: Primary paper section 2: base/residual/test-curve method, fit interval and k(f)=1/(1+2.2 f^2), f in MHz. The proposed empirical speed-up method is not adopted.
